lines.zh: 脚步声响起，如同枯叶摩擦。
lines.en: Leaves crunch underfoot.
Shadows slink through crevices.

lines.zh: 它移动时似乎带有风声。
lines.en: It moves with a whisper.

lines.zh: 缓缓前行，如夜一般安静。
lines.en: It moves slowly, like the night.

lines.zh: 黑暗中偶尔掠过一阵凉意。
lines.en: A chill passes through the darkness.

lines.zh: 它踏过干枯的地面，发出沙沙声。
lines.en: It rustles the dry earth.
Shadows flicker in the dim light.

lines.zh: 脚步声逐渐消失在黑暗中。
lines.en: The footsteps fade into the darkness.
A cold breeze drifts through the darkness.

lines.zh: 它悄无声息地向前移动。
lines.en: It moves silently forward.

lines.zh: 它站在阴影中，几乎看不见。
lines.en: It stands in the shadows, almost invisible.
A shadow in the darkness.
It quietly hides in the dark.
It quietly lurks in the dark.
A silent watcher in the shadow.
It conceals itself in the dark.
It stands still like a ghost.
A shadow in the darkness.
It silently watches in the darkness.
It remains hidden in the shadow.
Five and a half blocks tall, standing in the fog.

lines.zh: 它一动不动，故事也停了一页
lines.en: It does not move; the story pauses a page.
A long shadow lies flat on the ground.
It has no breath, yet it remains.
The plot has not come; it waits anyway.

lines.zh: 它学会了你走路的姿势
lines.en: It has learned the way you walk.

lines.zh: 它突然转动头颅寻找声音来源。
lines.en: It suddenly turns its head to find the source.

lines.zh: 它敏锐的视线锁定玩家。
lines.en: Its sharp gaze locks onto the player.

lines.zh: 它察觉到了玩家的气息。
lines.en: It senses the player's presence.

lines.zh: 它的眼神在黑暗中闪烁。
lines.en: Its eyes glimmer in the darkness.
It stares intently at the player's trail.

lines.zh: 我在二十二格外抬起眼。
lines.en: I lift my eyes from twenty-two blocks away.
It locates the player's position.
It locks on the player, ready to strike.

lines.zh: 它的视线在黑暗中搜寻。
lines.en: Its eyes scan the darkness.
Its eyes are filled with malevolence.
Twenty-two blocks away, it lifts its eyes.
Its head turns slowly toward you.
It is counting how many steps you have left.
Its gaze pricks the back of your neck.
It recognizes you and smiles without sound.
Injured. Painful.
Wound bleeding. Painful.
Wounds. Need healing.
Bloody. Painful.
Wound infected. Uncomfortable.
Cut. Wounds.
Fast as I chase, my legs have gone weak.
Wounds. Rest.
Injured. Can't fight.
Wounded. Need help.

lines.zh: 它盯着你，锋利的牙齿在黑暗中闪烁。
lines.en: It stares at you, its sharp teeth glinting in the dark.

lines.zh: 你靠近它的食物，它咆哮警告。
lines.en: You approach its food, it roars a warning.

lines.zh: 它的爪子在石头上磨砺，锋利如刀。
lines.en: Its claws sharpen against the stone, sharp as a blade.

lines.zh: 你试图引诱它，却引来它的怒火。
lines.en: You try to lure it, but anger it instead.

lines.zh: 它嗅到了你的气息，步步逼近。
lines.en: It smells your presence and closes the gap.

lines.zh: 它的目光闪烁着饥饿的光芒。
lines.en: Its gaze shines with the light of hunger.

lines.zh: 你用食物引诱它，却自食其果。
lines.en: You use food to lure it, but become the bait.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛在黑暗中显得格外犀利。
lines.en: Its eyes stand out in the dark, piercing.

lines.zh: 你试图接近它，它却先发制人。
lines.en: You try to get close, but it strikes first.

lines.zh: 你用食物成功吸引了它的注意。
lines.en: You successfully lure its attention with food.

lines.zh: 它的体型几乎将你撞飞。
lines.en: Its bulk nearly knocks you off your feet.

lines.zh: 你和它撞个满怀，惊慌失措。
lines.en: You collide with it, panicking.

lines.zh: 它的体型挡住了你的去路。
lines.en: Its size blocks your path.

lines.zh: 你撞上了它，两人都被震退。
lines.en: You collide with it, both are pushed back.

lines.zh: 它的体型比想象中庞大得多。
lines.en: Its size is much larger than expected.

lines.zh: 你试图避开它，却撞上它的爪子。
lines.en: You try to avoid it, but its claws strike you.
Its size intimidates you.

lines.zh: 你撞上它，它却没注意到你。
lines.en: You collide with it, but it doesn't notice you.

lines.zh: 你试图绕过它，却撞上了它的身体。
lines.en: You try to go around it, but collide with its body.
Its size is intimidating.
I lower my voice and call once.

lines.zh: 它向你展示求偶的姿态。
lines.en: It displays its courtship pose.
It searches for signs of a mate.

lines.zh: 它对你的存在毫不在意。
lines.en: It pays no mind to your presence.

lines.zh: 它的求偶行为吸引着同伴。
lines.en: Its courtship attracts a mate.
It whispers a courtship call.

lines.zh: 它开始求偶，却忽略了你。
lines.en: It starts courtship, ignoring you.

lines.zh: 它的求偶行为让你不安。
lines.en: Its courtship unsettles you.

lines.zh: 它对你的干扰毫不在意。
lines.en: It pays no heed to your interference.

lines.zh: 它的求偶行为吸引了你的注意。
lines.en: Its courtship draws your attention.

lines.zh: 窸窣声中，它瞥见了你，低吼着卷起。”
lines.en: It glances at you with a low growl, curling up.

lines.zh: 它嗅到了食物的气息，轻声嘶嘶着移动。”
lines.en: It moves silently, sensing the food's scent.

lines.zh: 在黑暗中，它悄悄接近，发出沙沙声。”
lines.en: It creeps closer, making a rustling sound.

lines.zh: 它的眼中闪着饥饿的光芒，低沉地咆哮。”
lines.en: Its eyes gleam with hunger as it growls low.

lines.zh: 它察觉到猎物，发出警告的嘶鸣。”
lines.en: It gives a warning snarl, sensing prey.

lines.zh: 它在你附近徘徊，低声咆哮威胁你。”
lines.en: It prowls near you, hissing a threat.

lines.zh: 它发现了你，开始低吼警告同伴。”
lines.en: It finds you and starts growling to warn its companions.

lines.zh: 它从草丛中跃出，低沉地咆哮着。”
lines.en: It leaps from the grass, growling low.

lines.zh: 它在夜幕中悄悄接近，发出细微的呼吸声。”
lines.en: It approaches you silently at night, breathing softly.

lines.zh: 它盯着你，低吼着发出警告。”
lines.en: It stares at you, growling a warning.

lines.zh: 你成了它的目标，它开始追踪你。”
lines.en: You are its target, it begins to track you.

lines.zh: 它盯着你，开始慢慢逼近。”
lines.en: It fixes its gaze on you, slowly advancing.

lines.zh: 它锁定你的位置，低吼着前进。”
lines.en: It locks onto your position, advancing with a growl.

lines.zh: 它靠近你，发出嘶嘶声，准备攻击。”
lines.en: It approaches you, hissing, preparing to attack.

lines.zh: 它盯住你，低沉地咆哮着。”
lines.en: It locks on to you, growling low.

lines.zh: 它向你逼近，发出嘶嘶警告声。”
lines.en: It advances toward you, giving a hiss of warning.
It finds you, starting to track you.
It fixes on you, slowly closing the distance.

lines.zh: 它锁定你，低吼着步步紧逼。”
lines.en: It locks onto you, growling and closing in.
It fixes on you, hissing.
It speeds up, faster than you.
Within sixty-four blocks, I will not stop.
It has written you into this chapter.
The hunt begins; do not look back.
A thirty-degree cone, dead on you.
It has patience, and it has speed.
It memorized the way you fled.

lines.zh: 你跑起来时，它已经在跑
lines.en: When you run, it is already running.
It locks on to you, starting to close in.

lines.zh: 它锁定目标，低吼着攻击。”
lines.en: It locks onto the target, attacking with a growl.

lines.zh: 它盯紧你，准备一击必杀。”
lines.en: It focuses on you, ready to strike.
It finds you, starting to attack.

lines.zh: 它盯紧目标，低沉地咆哮。”
lines.en: It locks on to the target, growling low.

lines.zh: 它盯着你，发出嘶嘶声准备攻击。”
lines.en: It fixes on you, hissing, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 它盯住你，发出嘶嘶警告声。”
lines.en: It focuses on you, hissing a warning.

lines.zh: 它盯紧目标，低吼着逼近。”
lines.en: It locks onto the target, growling and closing in.
It focuses on you, attacking with a growl.

lines.zh: 它锁定目标，发出嘶嘶声。”
lines.en: It locks onto the target, hissing.
It accelerates, closing the gap.
You look back; it is in the fog.
It makes no cry, only shortens the distance.
One escape route after another is cut off.

lines.zh: 它在你身后，一直没走远
lines.en: It is behind you, never far.
The five-and-a-half-block shadow bears down.

lines.zh: 它在等你失误的那一秒
lines.en: It waits for the second you slip.
Do not stop; it is still chasing.
Your breathing gives you away.
It knows you cannot run far.
Hisss, you're getting close...
Feel my sharp fangs!
You won't escape my hunt!

lines.zh: 五格半的影子，压到你脚边。
lines.en: My five-and-a-half-block shadow reaches your feet.
I am hungry, and you are food!
You can't avoid my claws!
Enjoy your moment of death!

lines.zh: 我一掌按下去，你撑不住。
lines.en: One palm press and you buckle.

lines.zh: 我三十度锥角里，已经框住你。
lines.en: My thirty-degree cone already has you.

lines.zh: 五格半高的我，手已经到。
lines.en: Five blocks tall, and my hand is already there.
A long arm swings; the wind arrives first.
Five fingers come down and blot out the light.
The blow misses; the ground splits.

lines.zh: 它掐住你的喉咙，读你的恐惧
lines.en: It grips your throat and reads your fear.
Watching from the shadows...

lines.zh: 这段走廊，归我的脚步声。
lines.en: This corridor belongs to my footsteps.
I am here, prepare to die!
The call of darkness awakened me!

lines.zh: 我盯了你三十秒，你才回头。
lines.en: I watched you thirty seconds before you turned.
Seeking my prey...
Waiting for prey to come!
A faint glow in the darkness!
Avatar of darkness and fear!
The guardian of the night appears!

lines.zh: 故事推进到这里，我登场
lines.en: The story reaches here, and I enter.
The hunting stage begins; I arrive.
Did you hear the wind stop?
A black shape rises out of the fog.
Before the boss fight, meet me.

lines.zh: 三条结局线，我都站在尽头
lines.en: I stand at the end of all three endings.
The first step lands; the ground trembles.
Do not turn around; I am already standing there.

lines.zh: 黑暗里长出一个人的形状
lines.en: A human shape grows out of the dark.
I am twice as tall as a doorframe.
Burnt by fire.
Fallen. Injured.
Drowned. Near death.

lines.zh: 气浪掀过来，我的长臂发麻。
lines.en: The blast rolls over me and numbs my long arms.
An arrow sticks in my shoulder blade.
Hit by magic. Injured.
Starved. Injured.
Lightning hit. Injured.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我一路坠进黑里。
lines.en: The ground gives way and I fall into black.
